segments.source: A type representing the sparsity structure of a sparse complex matrix.
segments.ko: A type representing the sparsity structure of a sparse complex matrix.

segments.source: The sparsity structure is represented in *block compressed sparse column* (block CSC) format.
segments.ko: The value of this property is [`nil`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ObjectiveC/nil-227m0) if switching between multiple output sources isn’t currently possible.

segments.source: The matrix is divided into a regular grid of `rowCount x columnCount` blocks each of size `blockSize x blockSize`, and only blocks containing a non-zero entry are stored.
segments.ko: ARKit은 LiDAR 스캐너를 사용해 이 거리를 샘플링하고, 그 결과를 세션의 [`currentFrame`](arsession/currentframe.md)에 있는 [`smoothedSceneDepth`](arframe/smoothedscenedepth.md) property로 제공합니다.

segments.source: CSC format is used to store the locations of these blocks.
segments.ko: CSC format is used to store the locations of these blocks.

segments.source: For each block column, a list of block row indices for non-zero blocks are stored, and the lists for each column are stored contiguously one after the other.
segments.ko: For each block column, a list of block row indices for non-zero blocks are stored, and the lists for each column are stored contiguously one after the other.

segments.source: Hence the row indices for column j are given by rowIndices`[columnStarts[j]:columnStarts[j+1]]`, where `columnStarts[]` is storing the location of the first index in each column.
segments.ko: Hence the row indices for column j are given by rowIndices`[columnStarts[j]:columnStarts[j+1]]`, where `columnStarts[]` is storing the location of the first index in each column.

segments.source: If the blockSize is `1`, then this format is exactly equivalent to standard CSC format.

CSR format data can be simulated by using a blockSize of `1` and setting the transpose attribute (strictly this is still a transposed CSC matrix, so `rowCount` and `columnCount` will be transposed compared to true CSR).
segments.ko: ARKit은 LiDAR 지원 기기에서만 scene depth를 지원하므로 scene depth를 활성화하려고 시도하기 전에 [`supportsFrameSemantics(_:)`](arconfiguration/supportsframesemantics(_:).md)로 기기 지원 여부를 확인합니다.

segments.source: **`columnStarts`**: Specifies where each (block) column starts in rowIndices array.
segments.ko: **`columnStarts`**: Specifies where each (block) column starts in rowIndices array.

segments.source: **`rowIndices`**: Specifies the (block) row indices of the matrix.
segments.ko: **`rowIndices`**: Specifies the (block) row indices of the matrix.

segments.source: **`attributes`**: The attribute meta-data for the matrix, for example whether the matrix is symmetric (Hermitian) and only half the entries are stored.
segments.ko: **`attributes`**: The attribute meta-data for the matrix, for example whether the matrix is symmetric (Hermitian) and only half the entries are stored.

segments.source: **`blockSize`**: The block size of the matrix.
segments.ko: **`blockSize`**: The block size of the matrix.
